name: qfd_su_lane_ml15_a-ml15r2-COMMIT
purpose: ml15r2: first real route of the ML15 lane (ml15 stopped by a bench configuration error, fixed in tb_qfd_su_vm_bv). Production TP8 SU successor:64-lane parent cannot reuse ML7 hard tile at VL15; local arithmetic pipeline QLA4/QLM5 preserved, each lane boundary registered; M5 leaf, local CTS, parent RD2 registered relay seams. Parent footprint replanned by qwen_die. Added8 memory alignment cycles vs ML7, golden arithmetic unchanged.
